title: Customer continues a session without signing in again

card.i_want: my session to refresh itself while I shop
card.so_that: a long browse does not throw away my cart at the checkout step

intent: A customer can take their time choosing without being logged out mid-purchase, which is where carts are abandoned for no business reason.

acceptance_criteria.scenario_name: an expired session is refreshed and the refresh token rotates
given: a customer whose access token has expired and whose refresh token is 3 days old
acceptance_criteria.when: the customer presents the refresh token
then: a new access token and a NEW refresh token are issued
the presented refresh token is no longer usable

acceptance_criteria.scenario_name: a refresh token at exactly 14 days is refused
given: a refresh token issued exactly 14 days ago
then: the refresh is refused and a fresh sign-in is required

acceptance_criteria.scenario_name: replaying an already-rotated refresh token invalidates the family
given: a refresh token that was already exchanged once
acceptance_criteria.when: the same token is presented a second time
then: the refresh is refused and no second live session is minted
every session descended from that token is revoked and a fresh sign-in is required

acceptance_criteria.scenario_name: a revoked session cannot be refreshed back to active
given: a session in the revoked state after a logout
acceptance_criteria.when: a refresh token from that session is presented
then: the refresh is refused and the session stays revoked

acceptance_criteria.scenario_name: session activity is recorded without exposing the token
then: an audit event records the actor, the time and the outcome
no token value appears in the event

pii_fields.justification: session tokens are credential-class data that must never be logged
pii_fields.treatment: hashed or opaque; never logged or displayed

audit_events.justification: refresh and revocation are security events that must be attributable

idempotency.justification: a replayed refresh token must not mint a second live session
idempotency.treatment: single-use rotation with family invalidation on replay

reversibility.justification: rotation is irreversible for the presented token
reversibility.compensating_action: invalidate the session family and require a fresh sign-in

authn_authz.justification: refresh extends an authenticated identity and is the obvious lateral-movement target

regulatory.justification: PDPA B.E. 2562 s24 account security governs session credentials

tipping_off.justification: no financial-crime context in session management

edge_case_ledger.justification: refresh is serialised per session family by the rotation itself
rotation writes one record in one store, so there is no half-written outcome
